semantic.value: Scraper-mode memory consolidation sends prompt into active browser tab via scraper_service.chat() with stored chat_url, waits for model response, parses JSON, applies memory updates — unlike API mode which uses fire-and-forget backend Qwen calls. Frontend createChat() awaits /api/memory/consolidate-scraper in scraper mode before creating new chat.

Browser chat URLs are stored in SQLite chats.chat_url column (auto-migrated). Saved after every scraper response via save_chat_url(). Retrieved via get_chat_url() to navigate scraper back to correct conversation instead of opening fresh empty chat.

When scraper_service.chat() receives a chat_id that differs from self.active_chat_id and no chat_url is provided, it opens a brand new browser chat via engine.new_chat() — causing messages to be sent into empty conversations. Fix: always pass chat_url when calling scraper_service.chat() for non-active chats.

Two consolidation endpoints: POST /api/memory/consolidate (API mode, uses service.chat with parent_id threading) and POST /api/memory/consolidate-scraper (scraper mode, uses scraper_service.chat with chat_url navigation). Both parse JSON response and apply add/delete operations to Memory.json and Protected.json.

phantom_bot at /home/sifat/hdd/projects/phantom_bot uses pyproject.toml (setuptools), entry in bot/main.py, config in config.py, core logic in bot/bot.py. Dependencies: python-telegram-bot>=21,<22, python-dotenv, requests, aiohttp, pymongo[srv], yt-dlp, telethon==1.44.0, fpdf2, pillow.

SkillParser._hold_start() in engine/skills.py failed to hold partial tags split across SSE streaming chunks when attributes were mid-stream. The check `any(tag.startswith(partial))` only matched when partial was shorter than the tag name; once attributes arrived (e.g. 'view_file path="/home/...'), no known tag started with that string. Fix: added `or partial.startswith(tag)` to also match when the tag name has fully arrived but attributes are still streaming. Line ~1165.

semantic.key: Sable background command final_log NameError bug
semantic.value: handle_execute_background_command in engine/skills.py referenced undefined variable `final_log` on lines 479 and 485 instead of `log_path`. Would cause NameError crash on every background job launch. Fixed by replacing both occurrences with `log_path`.

phantom_bot webhook support added to bot/main.py and config.py. Webhook activates only when USE_WEBHOOK=True AND IS_LOCAL!=True. Uses PTB v21 run_webhook() with bot token as URL path for security. Config vars: WEBHOOK_URL (public HTTPS domain), WEBHOOK_PORT (default 8443). Polling is default fallback for all other combinations. Health check server runs alongside in both modes via start_health_server().

semantic.key: Sable NEVER restart during active session
semantic.value: CRITICAL: Never run systemctl --user restart sable while Sifat is actively chatting through Sable. The conversation runs through Sable itself — restarting kills the connection mid-conversation. Fixes to skills.py or other engine files are saved to disk but only take effect on next natural/manual restart.

episodic.value: Scraper consolidation failed with 'no JSON object found' because the consolidation prompt was sent to a fresh empty browser chat instead of the active conversation. Root cause: missing chat_url parameter caused scraper to call engine.new_chat(). Fixed by adding chat_url column to chats table, storing URL after scraper responses, and passing it in consolidate-scraper endpoint.

procedural.value: When scraper messages fail silently (empty answer, no error), check: 1) Is chat_url being passed to scraper_service.chat()? Without it, mismatched chat_id triggers new_chat() instead of navigating to existing conversation. 2) Check stream_events logic around line 605 in engine/scraper.py where chat_id != self.active_chat_id branches. 3) Verify browser tab is alive via _is_browser_alive() check.

When phantom_bot is reported broken: 1) Check git log/status for uncommitted changes or recent bad commits. 2) Inspect bot/main.py entry point and config.py for import/config errors. 3) Verify .env exists and has required vars. 4) Try running with uv run python -m bot.main to catch runtime errors. 5) Check if dependencies need uv sync.

When Sable skill tags fail intermittently: 1) Check _hold_start() logic for split-tag handling — verify both tag.startswith(partial) AND partial.startswith(tag) checks exist. 2) Test with simulated multi-chunk streaming using standalone script (not inline python -c which gets intercepted by the live parser). 3) Check for undefined variables in handlers (grep for suspicious names). 4) Verify syntax with py_compile before declaring fix. 5) NEVER restart sable during active session.

To deploy phantom_bot with webhook on Render: Set env vars IS_LOCAL=False, USE_WEBHOOK=True, WEBHOOK_URL=https://app-name.onrender.com, WEBHOOK_PORT=8443 (or Render-assigned port). Render auto-provisions SSL on .onrender.com. Free tier caveat: spins down after inactivity, Telegram webhooks don't count as keep-alive activity — use paid tier or external uptime pinger. Bot token is used as webhook URL path automatically.
